nome_jp: 頂竜連結 バジュエン・ザ・ローラ
testo:
EX Life
Speed Attacker
Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature, destroy all your opponent's creatures that have power 3000 or less.
■ During your opponent's turn, when this creature's "EX Life" shield leaves your shield zone, tap all cards in your opponent's mana zone. At the start of your opponent's next turn, those cards don't untap.
